searchText: Nether receipt or transaction. Only referenced by block hash There is `GetPooledTransactions` which appears to fetch transactions by hash. I'm just surprised there isn't a similar one for receitps. Only available for transactions in the pool (and in theory only for transactions that have been advertised ) Not available for historic transactions? Not that I'm aware of In theory clients could do so but I'm not sure whether any actually do Only for advertised and still in pool ,iirc it says explicitly in the eip (or rather strongly recommends)
